description: A no-code RAG server that keeps answers in sync with your documents. Works with 8 vector databases. Built on Pathway.

latest_release.name: serviette 0.1.8 — llm-app is now serviette
latest_release.body:
> **llm-app is now serviette.** This repository used to host Pathway's LLM app templates. They are all still available, unchanged, in [`pathway/examples/llm-app`](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app). The repository itself now hosts **serviette**, a no-code RAG server built from what we learned from those templates. **serviette is a no-code RAG server that keeps its answers in sync with your documents.** Point it at a folder, pick a vector database and an embedder in one YAML file, and you get a chat UI and a REST API that answer from those documents and cite their sources. Edits, new files and deletions show up in the answers within seconds, with no re-indexing step.

## Try it ```bash pip install serviette export PATHWAY_LICENSE_KEY=... # free: https://pathway.com/framework/get-license export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... serviette demo --embedder openai # → chat at http://localhost:8989 ``` To run it on your own documents, use `serviette wizard` and then `serviette up`. See the [README](https://github.com/pathwaycom/serviette#readme). ## What's inside - **No code:** one YAML file, or have `serviette wizard` generate it. - **8 vector databases:** DuckDB (embedded, the default), pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Pinecone, MongoDB Atlas. Each one has integration tests against a real instance. - **Live sources:** local folders, Google Drive, S3/MinIO, SharePoint, FTP/SFTP/WebDAV. - **Multimodal:** PDFs with tables, Office documents and scans by default. Audio and video are added automatically when the corresponding API keys are set. - **Retrieval options, each enabled in config:** hybrid BM25 + vector search, reranking, adaptive RAG, query decomposition and MMR. - **Fully local option:** local embeddings with DuckDB, with no API keys for indexing. - **Separate indexer and server:** the server is stateless and scales horizontally, and the indexer splits work across worker processes. ## Benchmarks - **Indexing:** 50 GB of text (26M pages, 17M files) in 6 hours on a 96-core machine with local embeddings, with peak indexer memory of 14.65 GiB. See the [benchmark details](https://github.com/pathwaycom/serviette/tree/main/benchmarks/realtime-data-indexing). - **Accuracy:** 0.50 gold-article recall on [FRAMES](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12941), versus 0.15 for the paper's BM25 baseline. Adding serviette to gpt-5 improves gpt-5's accuracy by +5.2 pp. See the [full report](https://github.com/pathwaycom/serviette/blob/main/benchmarks/frames/REPORT.md). ## Coming from llm-app? | llm-app template | Where it is now | Closest serviette feature | |---|---|---| | `question_answering_rag` | [templates/question_answering_rag](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates/question_answering_rag) | `serviette up`: chat + `/api/v1` | | `document_indexing` | [templates/document_indexing](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates/document_indexing) | `serviette indexer` + `/api/v1/retrieve` | | `adaptive_rag` | [templates/adaptive_rag](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates/adaptive_rag) | `rag.adaptive` | | `multimodal_rag` | [templates/multimodal_rag](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates/multimodal_rag) | multimodal parsing, on by default | | `video_rag_twelvelabs` | [templates/video_rag_twelvelabs](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates/video_rag_twelvelabs) | video parsing via `TWELVELABS_API_KEY` | | `private_rag`, `slides_ai_search`, `drive_alert`, `unstructured_to_sql_on_the_fly`, `document_store_mcp_server` | [templates/](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app/templates) | — | The cookbooks are in [`examples/llm-app/c

detail.readme_excerpt:
# serviette > **Looking for llm-app templates?** All templates, cookbooks and examples > are still available in full in the > [Pathway repository under `examples/llm-app`](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway/tree/main/examples/llm-app).

**A no-code, always up-to-date RAG server for any vector database — built on the [Pathway Live Data Framework](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway).** Point serviette at a folder of documents, pick a vector database and an embedder in one YAML file, and run two commands: you get a chat and a REST API that answer from those documents and cite their sources. From then on, any change to the documents — an edit, a new file, a deletion — is reflected in the answers within seconds. serviette runs on Pathway, which needs a **free license key** — one click at (GitHub or LinkedIn sign-in). Every command below expects it in `PATHWAY_LICENSE_KEY`. Try it in four commands: ```bash pip install serviette export PATHWAY_LICENSE_KEY=... # free: https://pathway.com/framework/get-license export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... serviette demo --embedder openai # → chat at http://localhost:8989 ``` **Use pip 23.1 or newer** (`python -m pip install -U pip` first): older pip lacks the resolver improvements this dependency tree needs and can take hours. This indexes a [small bundled corpus](https://github.com/pathwaycom/serviette/tree/main/serviette/demo/corpus) (a fictional coffee-machine company) into `./serviette-demo/docs` and opens a chat over it. Edit or drop files into that folder while it runs — the answers follow within seconds.

One command to a live RAG stack — then edit a document and watch the answer change.
